extras: The UI is currently Chinese only; mobile/touch behavior has not yet been tested on physical devices.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin for OneNote-style navigation through your existing folders and notes.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of navigating large vaults by allowing users to switch between conceptual "notebook" views without displaying the entire folder hierarchy.

relations.evidence: Dual-pane browsing with folders, tags, properties, previews, keyboard navigation, and manual ordering.
Notebook/section/page navigation in a popup or sidebar; configurable root folder, folder-note subpages, and drag reordering/moves.

summary: A plugin that allows users to navigate their existing vault folders as notebooks, providing compact, single-level navigation and direct file management.
